mentions.name: Banksia
mentions.description: A private consumer whole genome sequencing service, positioned as the 'Mullvad VPN' of sequencing. Samples are identified only by a client number not tied to the person's personal identifying information, so the sequencer never needs to know the identity of the person being sequenced.
mentions.problem: Consumer genome sequencing typically ties results to personal identity; there is a market for privacy-preserving sequencing where clients don't have to surrender their PII.
mentions.source_excerpt: - https://banksia.bio: I suspect there is a market for private consumer whole genome sequencing services. Think "Mullvad vpn" of sequencing - I shouldn't have to know the identity of the person I am sequencing, and they can be identified with a client number not tied to their PII.
